title: Aspect of the End (AOTE)
description: The Aspect of the End from Hypixel, but completely in vanilla!
body:
## Aspect of the End (AOTE)
### Description
Adds a fully working Aspect of the End Diamond Sword with teleportation!
DOES NOT INCLUDE MANA COST/DELAY

It even functions like a diamond sword, killing mobs with similar damage!

### Coming Soon:
- Speed Buff when used

### made by gamerbenyt :D
